official_definition: Resonance Blast: XX(/YY) (When Attacks) You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon/deploy a "XX"(/"YY")-named card, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining card(s).

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Resonance Blast] or [Resonance Blast: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Resonance Blast]", "give [Resonance Blast]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
